question: Narthaki Nataraj, awarded with Padma Shri in 2019 is an Indian _________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Bharatanatyam__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Narthaki Nataraj:-

 
 
• ​Narthaki Nataraj is an **accomplished Indian classical dancer known for her expertise in the art form of Bharatanatyam,** which is a traditional dance style originating from the southern part of India.
 
• She** holds the distinction of being one of the most prominent transgender women to have gained recognition in the field of classical dance.**
 
• Narthaki Nataraj **was born in 1964 in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• From a young age, **she displayed a keen interest and talent in Bharatanatyam.**
 
• She trained rigorously in this dance form, honing her skills and mastering the intricate techniques and expressions that are integral to Bharatanatyam.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Shri in 2019 for her significant contributions to the field of Indian classical dance, specifically for her exceptional skills and dedication to the art of Bharatanatyam.
